newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends lower, ignores Dow, Intel rally.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends lower, ignores Dow, Intel rally.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks ended lower on Wednesday, ignoring for the second day a sharp rally in the Dow industrials.
Continued concern over growth prospects of high technology companies kept buyers at bay, despite sharp gains in tech bellwether Intel Corp, traders said.
"Some stocks rallied at the close trying to follow Intel," one trader said. But the rally faltered, he added.
The Nasdaq composite finished off about 2-1/2 points at 1210. Losing issues beat gainers by a 11-to-10 ratio.
The losses came as the Dow posted a 93-point rise to about 6680. On Monday the Nadsaq composite fell 3-1/2 points while the Dow shot up 135.

Intel rose three to 134 after a Merrill Lynch analyst raised his earnings forecast for the company on Wednesday citing prospects for its Pentium MMX chip. The analyst had cut his earnings forecast for Intel on Tuesday.
But among other tech names, Cisco Systems Inc fell 2-5/8 to 47-1/2 and Sun Microsystems Inc fell 1-15/16 to 27-7/16.
Clarify Inc shrank 9-3/4 to seven after the help-desk software developer said it expects little, if any, revenue growth in the second quarter over the first.
